title: Plant Manager
text:
**Role Description:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the management, planning, and coordination of all precast manufacturing operations to meet DVP business goals, while providing leadership to all plant and yard personnel.

**General Supervisory Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Create and manage production schedules based on manpower, customer demand, and DVP business goals
* Meet with General Manager as needed to review any safety concerns, production & quality issues, personnel needs, and inventory levels
* Conducts daily supervisor meetings to discuss production schedules, concerns, opportunities for improvement and to ensure ongoing organizational teamwork
* Hold monthly plant safety meetings and review any safety related deficiencies and submit recommendations to DVP senior management
* Track key performance metrics and hold direct reports accountable for results
* Ensure all production and yard operations meet DVP quality control standards
* Track and manage the inventory levels of finished goods
* Oversee and manage all incoming materials to ensure adequate inventory levels are met
* Continually collect and review data to reduce inefficiencies and waste
* Successfully hire, supervise, train, and retain production/yard staff
* Evaluate and review employee’s performance for the purpose of determining skill level and training needs
* Coach and mentor employees to allow for increased responsibilities and career advancement. Lead by example.
* Promote and maintain a clean work environment
* Recommend purchases of additional equipment for efficiency, cost reductions and/or quality improvements
* Successfully work with Quality Control/Project Management to meet customer demand and expectations
* Perform any other duties as assigned by the General Manager

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* Supervision of Plant Supervisors
* Leading by example, create and sustain a safe working environment for the facility

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Eligible to work in the U.S
* Successful experience in precast plant management
* Ability to read contract documents, engineering specifications and drawings
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
* Excellent time management skills
* Highly organized and self-motivated
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Work with computer as necessary (Microsoft Word, Excel)

**Physical Requirements:**

* Standing and walking for extended periods of time
* Exposure to fluctuating weather conditions including extreme cold or heat
* Must be in good physical and mental health

**Education and Experience:**

* 10+ years of precast concrete experience
* 5+ years production supervision or related experience

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Simple IRA with a Company Match
* Paid Time-off

Benefit Conditions:

* 60-Day waiting period
* Only full-time employees eligible

**Schedule:**

* Monday through Friday, minimum 45 hrs. Overtime & weekends may be required to meet project schedules.

**Pay Range:** Commensurate with experience

Pay: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
